Analyze key character motivations in Chapter 3.

content_blocks.content: The narrative of Chapter 3 centres on The Dice Game. The characters face choices that test the boundaries of Yoga — the cosmic order that governs all actions.

content_blocks.english_translation: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to its fruits.
content_blocks.content: This verse defines selfless action — the bedrock of the Gita's teaching.
Yoga as explored in The Dice Game reveals that true freedom lies in detachment from outcome while remaining fully committed to righteous action.
By the end of Chapter 3, the reader understands that the battlefield of Kurukshetra is also the battlefield of the human mind — where every soul must choose between ego and truth.
